newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL stock market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: KL stock market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian stock market is closed on Monday for a Hindu festival. It reopens on Tuesday.
On Friday, a rebound in heavyweight Tenaga Nasional stock helped push the key share market index higher at the close, but interest was mainly on secondary stocks.
The Composite Index closed at 1,179.60, up 1.67 points, after hitting an intraday low of 1,173.24.
The Second Board index rose 6.09 points to 643.48.
Market volume was 276 million shares, and gainers led losers 298 to 224.
